theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a government/civic service app, the UI must command trust and authority while remaining highly accessible. Stark white backgrounds with structural greys are accented by Bangladesh's national flag colors (Green and Red) to provide clear, actionable hierarchy. Glassmorphism is used to elevate priority content (like the DC profile and Restaurant menus) without cluttering the screen.

font_families.heading: Hind Siliguri, Noto Sans Bengali, sans-serif

typography.guidelines: Do not translate Bangla text. Keep UI components cleanly spaced. Avoid line-height issues common in Bangla typography by setting explicit loose line heights.

glassmorphism.usage: Restaurant menu modals, DC profile card, Header when scrolling.

splash_screen.logo_animation: Smooth fade in and scale up

header_and_drawer.layout: Fixed top, glassmorphism, hamburger on left, title centered, notification on right
header_and_drawer.drawer_content: Developer info (Image, name, email, close button)

hero_slider.indicators: Dots, active dot is primary green, inactive is white/50
hero_slider.animation: Auto-slide with subtle zoom (Ken Burns effect)

services_grid.card_style: Soft card, centered icon, text-sm below icon. No gradients on card background, use green/red icons.

dc_profile_card.style: Glassmorphism elevated above a soft pattern background
dc_profile_card.layout: Avatar top-center (overlapping border), Name, Designation, Phone number
dc_profile_card.button: Primary Green CTA 'কল করুন', full width or wide pill

upazila_grid.style: Clean white cards with subtle grey borders. Tap to view details.

restaurant_menu_modal.style: Slide-up bottom sheet / modal. Backdrop blur heavily.
restaurant_menu_modal.image_viewer: Pinch-to-zoom enabled, vertical scrollable menu image.

bottom_navigation.style: White background, top border 1px grey. Active tab icon and label in Primary Green, inactive in Slate Grey.

admin_dashboard.style: Web-only. Clean Shadcn/UI style. Sidebar navigation. Data tables for CRUD operations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement mobile screens using React Native Expo and React Native Reanimated. Strict adherence to Bengali Unicode fonts via expo-google-fonts (Hind Siliguri). Use the defined color palette for UI components, avoiding overused gradients. Build the restaurant modal with a performant backdrop blur and use react-native-gesture-handler for pinch-to-zoom on the menu. For the Admin Web Panel, use standard React/Next with Shadcn UI.
